title: Collect long tasks
prompt: Return a new array of values at least the supplied minimum, preserving order and duplicates. Leave the original array intact.
hints: Start with an empty output list.
Test each value against the threshold.
Add qualifying values as you encounter them.
checks: (() => { const input = [1, 4]; const output = longTasks(input, 4); return output !== input && __same(input, [1, 4]); })()
feedback: Start with an empty output list.
